narrative: 这个镜头能在不剪切的情况下，把一场戏变成一张示意图。人物、桌子和街道之所以变成了平面图般的俯视效果，是因为摇臂已经升高并越过了它们，俯仰角度随之改变。
它不是一个静止的俯拍镜头：观众要跟随视角等级的变化一起“乘坐”这段运动。如果你本来就想要一个固定不动的正顶俯拍（Overhead Top-Down），或者一个简单的摇臂上升（Crane Up）本该一直朝前望向天际线，这就不是合适的工具。
如果始终没有到达俯视角度，那你做的只是一次摇臂上升。
how: 摇臂向上升起并向前弧形移动，遥控云台在摇臂越过主体时逐渐向下俯仰。最终接近正下方视角，或达到一个陡峭的高角度（High Angle）。
要留意摇臂的阴影是否遮住了主体，以及镜头面向新的窗户光源时主光是否发生变化。提示词：a crane over, arm rising and arcing forward until the camera looks nearly straight down.
when: 用它在不剪切的情况下把一场戏变成一张地图。具体例子：一场晚餐争执，最终桌子变成了一张棋盘。
如果最后一个画面仍然是朝前的宽景，就不要用摇臂越过。
vs: 摇臂上升（Crane Up）通常在升起并后拉的同时仍保持朝前的视角；正顶俯拍（Overhead Top-Down）则可以是一个固定不动、没有运动过程的俯视镜头。
小摇臂镜头（Jib Shot）可以在桌子上方做一个小规模的类似弧形运动；而摇臂越过则是持续攀升直至俯视视角的完整过程。
examples_film: 《铁面无私》（The Untouchables）在联合车站的楼梯上方使用摇臂高度，让整场动作变成了台阶与人体构成的示意图。《鸟人》（Birdman）则贯穿整个剧院空间，直到平面图与人脸共享同一条运动路径。
要学习的是这种“弧形升起转为俯视”的运镜方式，而不是年代戏的服装造型。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是一个从未真正俯视的摇臂上升，或者直接剪切到正顶俯拍。破绽在于：结尾画面仍是朝前的天际线，或者画面突然跳到了俯视视角。
解决办法：让摇臂沿一条完整路径运动，最终以陡峭的俯视角度收尾，主体依然能被辨认为一张地图。

faq.q: 电影中的摇臂越过（Crane Over）是什么？
faq.a: 它是一种摇臂运动：先升高再弧形移动，直到摄影机俯视画面，在同一条运动路径中同时完成高度变化和角度变化。

faq.q: 摇臂越过（Crane Over）与摇臂上升（Crane Up）的区别
faq.a: 摇臂上升通常在升起后拉的同时仍横向望向世界；摇臂越过则会持续运动，直到视角完全朝下，地面本身成为了画面。

faq.q: 什么时候应该使用摇臂越过？
faq.a: 当调度需要在不剪切的情况下变成一张地图时使用。如果你想要的是天际线，或者一个静止不动的俯拍固定镜头，就不要用它。

faq.q: 如何为 AI 图像或视频撰写摇臂越过的提示词？
faq.a: 描述摇臂升起并越过 [Subject]，最终几乎垂直向下俯视。强调这是一条连续的摇臂运动，禁止剪切到俯视视角。

narrative: The shot turns a scene into a diagram without cutting. Bodies, tables, and streets become plan view because the arm has climbed and pitched over them.
It is not a still overhead: the audience rides the change of rank. It is the wrong tool when you already want a locked top-down, or when a simple crane-up should keep looking forward at a skyline.
If you never reach a downward angle, you only craned up.
how: Boom up and arc forward, remote head tilting down as the arm passes over the subject. End nearly nadir or at a steep high angle.
Watch for the subject being covered by the arm's shadow and for changing key as you face new windows. Prompt a crane over, arm rising and arcing forward until the camera looks nearly straight down.
when: Use it to turn a scene into a map without cutting. Concrete beat: a dinner argument, then the table as a chessboard.
Do not crane over if the last frame is still a forward wide.
vs: A Crane Up typically keeps a forward look as it rises and eases back. An Overhead Top-Down can be a locked top-down with no ride.
A Jib Shot can do a small version of this arc over a table. Crane over is the continuous climb into downward view.
examples_film: The Untouchables uses crane height over the Union Station staircase so the action becomes a diagram of steps and bodies. Birdman rides theater space until floor plans and faces share one path.
Use the arc-into-down, not the period costumes.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a Crane Up that never looks down, or a cut to Overhead Top-Down. The tell is a forward skyline at the end, or a jump to top-down.
The fix: one arm path that finishes steeply downward, subject still readable as a map.

faq.q: What is Crane Over in film?
faq.a: It is a crane move that rises and arcs until the camera looks down, combining a height change with a change of angle in one path.
Crane up usually eases back while still looking across the world. Crane over continues until the view is downward and the floor becomes the picture.

faq.q: When should I use Crane Over?
faq.a: When blocking should become a map without a cut. Do not use it if you wanted a skyline or a still overhead lock-off.

faq.q: How do I prompt Crane Over for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write crane up and over [Subject], finishing nearly straight down. One continuous arm move. Ban a cut to top-down.
